text:
Luis Ortega: Heads-up: Citrine preview cohort B starts next Monday. We need final seat confirmations, telemetry opt-ins, and a short enablement touch to reduce churn risk. Can we centralize tracking in one checklist?
Priya V: I can run the checklist. do we have a strict deadline? ops needs 48h to provision seats after consent.
Luis Ortega: Deadline = Thursday 17:00 PT. ops provisioning window Fri morning.
Tom H: Quick Q: will we allow preview API keys with reduced quotas or require full test accounts? some partners prefer scoped keys.
Luis Ortega: Allow scoped preview keys. Tag any scoped-key accounts with `preview:scoped` in CRM.
Rae: I'll handle the initial outreach email and the quick demo. Drafting now.
Tom H: Re: telemetry  we should offer a privacy blurb and a one-click opt-in. If they decline, mark for AM follow-up (renewal risk).
Elena: I'll schedule a 30-min office hour during week 1. prefer Wed 10am PT. Put sign-up link in the invite.
ops-bot: Checklist created by Priya V  5 items. Reminder set for 2026-04-02T00:00:00Z.
Priya V: Pasting checklist snapshot:
```
- seats: invites sent + accepted count
- consent: telemetry opt-in OR decline reason
- keys: scoped vs full (tagged)
- enablement: office hour scheduled + slides linked
- survey: initial feature-check sent (deadline + link)
```
Rae: Draft outreach (short):
```
Subject: Citrine preview  final steps
Hi <FirstName>,
Quick next steps to join Citrine preview:
1) Accept invite
2) Choose telemetry opt-in (yes/no)
3) Pick API key type (scoped/full)
Sign up link: https://forms.redwood.com/citrine-join
Thanks, Rae (CS)
```
Tom H: Rate-limit note: last internal pilot hit bursts that triggered 429s when using naive retries. Ops, can we pre-warm soft limits for cohort B? otherwise include backoff guidance in onboarding.
Priya V: Ops, please run `/ops bump-preview citrine B 2x` if feasible. Also add a line in the email about backoff.
ops-bot: Ops request received. Ticket: OPS-7892. ETA 24h.
Elena: Survey draft ready: 4 quick ticks + 2 comments. Link: https://surveys.redwood.com/citrine-touchpoint
Luis Ortega: CRM action: tag any account without telemetry opt-in as `renewal-risk:high`. Ops to add tag by Friday noon.
Priya V: Owners: outreach = Rae; checklist owner = Priya; office hour = Elena; CRM tags = Tom; survey = Elena. React when done.
Rae: :white_check_mark:
Elena: :white_check_mark:
Tom H: :white_check_mark:
Priya V: :white_check_mark:
Luis Ortega: Thanks team. I'll assemble the outreach copy + AM alert once tags are applied.
